candidates.description: The productId parameter is concatenated directly into a MongoDB $where JavaScript expression, allowing arbitrary code execution on the database server.
candidates.rationale: Line 149 uses `$where: 'this.product == ' + productId` where productId originates from user-controlled request input. The $where operator evaluates a JavaScript expression server-side, so injecting a payload like `1; sleep(5000)` or `1; this.constructor.constructor('return process')()` achieves code execution. Verification: send a synthetic productId with a timing payload and observe response delay.
candidates.title: NoSQL injection via $where operator in chat route

candidates.description: The /rest/2fa/verify route lacks security.isAuthorized() middleware, allowing unauthenticated users to brute-force 2FA tokens.
candidates.rationale: Lines 477-480 register POST /rest/2fa/verify with only rateLimit middleware, while sibling endpoints /rest/2fa/status (line 482), /rest/2fa/setup (line 484), and /rest/2fa/disable (line 490) all require security.isAuthorized(). An unauthenticated attacker can submit TOTP tokens to any user's account. Verification: send a POST to /rest/2fa/verify without an Authorization header and confirm the request is processed rather than rejected with 401.
candidates.title: Missing authentication on 2FA verify endpoint
